stem: Several plants visibly lag the dominant reproductive morphology even though the room shares one schedule. What is the best record?
choices: Assign every plant the scheduled stage
Delete the exceptions from the sample
Document the dominant stage and the lagging subgroup separately
Assume the lagging plants are diseased
rationale: Document the dominant stage and the lagging subgroup separately. This response preserves the Course 002 evidence, identity, role-boundary or documentation principle being assessed.
